title: QFBench 2.0 Track-3 scenario config + run report
description: Two objects: `scenario` (input, mounted read-only) and `events` (output sidecar to trace.parquet). The trace.parquet message schema is fixed: [t_ns:int, agent_id:int, msg_type:str, side:str, price:int, size:int, order_id:int].

agent_mix.description: ABIDES agent type -> count (noise, value, momentum, market-maker, ...).

events_per_sec.description: primary metric; harness-measured, not self-reported, on the official image.
